remarks: This vacant WALKOUT lot offers a rare chance to build your custom dream home or investment property in an established, family-friendly neighborhood. At approximately 4,500 sq. ft. with a 30-foot building pocket, this prime location provides easy access to Jubilee Park's scenic ponds, walking trails, spray park, playgrounds, basketball courts, frisbee golf, and winter skating. Walking distance to schools, shopping, groceries, and everyday amenities, with quick access to Highway 16A, the Yellowhead, and Edmonton's west end. (id:67522)
